corrections.reason: The printed text at the start of line 28 clearly reads 'ቢስ ጋኔን' (archaic Andemta gloss for 'ጋኔን እኩይ'), which Stage 1 hallucinated/modernized as 'ክፉ'.
The Ge'ez verb is printed with 5th-order ኀምስ 'ኤ' ('ወይትኤዘዙ'), visible from the bottom-right loop on the glyph and matching 'ይኤዝዞሙ' in line 13.
The glyph is 6th-order 'ፅ' ('ትፈፅን', having a fever, matching 'ፈፀንታ' in line 12), not 'ድ'.
In Classical Ge'ez, the 3rd person feminine singular object suffix on 'ወአንሥኣ' ('and he raised her up', translated 'አሥነሣት' in line 11) is 4th-order 'ኣ', clearly visible with the shortened left leg.
The printed word has only four Fidels ('አድኗታል'); there is no extra 'ዋ' printed between 'ኗ' and 'ታ'.
The canonical Ge'ez Gospel text (Mark 1:32) and the printed glyphs clearly read 'ወእለሂ አኀዙ አጋንንት' ('and those whom demons seized', 3 letters 'አኀዙ'), which was misread as 'አኅዛነ'.
